subject.title: fix: keep native harness bridge tool caps local

question: Does the agent/session owner approve making runtime tool allowlists non-inheritable by default, with restricted embedded and cron callers explicitly opting into child inheritance?
rationale: The implementation is technically sound, but it intentionally changes a privilege non-escalation boundary and repository policy requires owner judgment for that authority contract.

options.title: Approve the explicit authority split
options.body: Keep the current local-by-default behavior and require genuine restricted runtimes to opt into child inheritance.

options.title: Require a typed authority mode
options.body: Replace the boolean with a closed local-versus-inheritable authority type before merging to make future caller intent harder to omit.

recommendation.title: Approve the explicit authority split
recommendation.body: Keep the current local-by-default behavior and require genuine restricted runtimes to opt into child inheritance.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced and merged the capability-profile layer that owns this policy distinction and has recent adjacent session-management history.
